correctness.rationale: As frozen, the auxiliary ratio at RESULT.md lines 31–41 is false as a universal statement: connected OFF is permitted, and A=V gives N_A=k, h=0 and a denominator identically zero. The complete corrected RESULT.md restricts that quotient to proper OFF components and explicitly covers the zero-variance case without a ratio. The undivided law remains valid for all allowed graphs. I reconstructed the general proof: product detailed balance and the connected ON graph give uniqueness and reversibility; exact exchange closure and canonical covariance give the weighted two-layer Poisson formula with factor 2χ. The OFF-null test (0,P₀h) has energy p(1−p)κ||P₀h||² and yields the all-rate bound. In the OFF-null/complement decomposition the complement block has an invertible limit, the cross blocks are O(κ), and the null block is pκI. The Schur complement is pκI+O(κ²), so the inverse has leading term P_D/(pκ) with bounded remainder, also covering an empty nullspace. The two-block complete-graph mode has ON eigenvalue nr and OFF eigenvalue zero; solving its two scalar Poisson equations gives the asserted exact expression. Independent exact verification of both benchmarks used the full ON/OFF chain over all k-subsets, one pinned Poisson coordinate, and the stationary variance 2Σπfu at κ=1/7, 1, 19/3. It agreed with both expressions. In the repaired quotient the denominator is χa(n−a)/n>0 for 1≤a<n, and P₀h=h, so division gives 2(1−p)/p. No other proof or scope change is needed.
residual_risks: The result assumes stationarity, symmetric exchanges, a common autonomous gate, and the limit T→∞ first. It does not assert a thermodynamic limit or a result for general gate paths.

value.rationale: The surviving corrected result answers a concrete structural question: identical equal-time occupation statistics can coexist with divergent integrated noise, but only when the field sees a conserved OFF-component number. The exact residue and finite-speed bound give quantitative tests for intermittent transport; neither all fields nor all disconnected graphs give a divergence for a specified field. The proper-component ratio and complete-graph benchmark tie that mechanism to a measurable static variance and known gate probability. This value survives removal of the undefined ratio at A=V and does not depend on presenting standard resolvent tools as new.
residual_risks: Value is for finite linear occupation observables, not a claim about macroscopic transport universality or higher cumulants.
